video_title: The 2016 Conference Finals almost cost us the greatest NBA Finals rematch ever | NBA Yesterday

quotes.speaker: David Dennis Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's dominant performance against the Toronto Raptors in 2016
quotes.excerpt: the King would go on to average 35 points in two straight sweeps against that Raptor squad.
quotes.quote: It is important to remember that 2016 was two years before the infamous LeBronto series. We didn't even know yet that the King would go on to average 35 points in two straight sweeps against that Raptor squad.

quotes.speaker: David Dennis Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's controversial kick on Steven Adams in 2016
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green would become public enemy number one and the playoffs big villain thanks to this kick
quotes.quote: In the midst of the beatdown, Draymond Green would become public enemy number one and the playoffs big villain thanks to this kick to Steven Adams. It is impossible to overstate what a talking point this was. Draymond swore it was a natural motion. Quite literally, everyone else disagreed.

quotes.speaker: David Dennis Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's legacy and the impact of his departure from OKC
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Durant probably doesn't leave a Thunder team that makes the Finals.
quotes.quote: Kevin Durant probably doesn't leave a Thunder team that makes the Finals. Or maybe he still leaves, but doesn't catch as much flack for joining a Warriors team he just beat. But if he wins the title, he stays, right? And he's just beaten LeBron without having to join a superteam.
